subject: math
name: Mathematics
course: Multi-Digit Arithmetic, Fraction Equivalence & Geometric Angles
title: Grade 4 Mathematics: Multi-Digit Arithmetic, Fraction Equivalence & Geometric Angles
overview: Grade 4 mathematics deepens students' conceptual understanding of place value, arithmetic operations, algebraic thinking, measurement, and geometry through rigorous problem-solving routines.
competencies: Demonstrate computational fluency and conceptual flexibility across grade-level operations.
Apply visual models, tape diagrams, and equations to represent and solve multi-step contextual word problems.
Analyze geometric shapes, measurement units, and spatial relationships.
Construct viable mathematical arguments and critique the reasoning of peers.

modules.title: Place Value, Rounding, and Algorithms for Addition and Subtraction to 1,000,000
modules.description: Extending place value understanding up to millions, rounding multi-digit numbers, and mastering standard addition/subtraction algorithms.

topics.title: Place Value of Multi-Digit Whole Numbers
topics.description: Comparing digit values where a digit in one place represents ten times what it represents in the place to its right.

topics.title: Multi-Digit Whole Number Addition and Subtraction
topics.description: Executing standard column algorithms fluently with regrouping across multiple places.

modules.title: Multi-Digit Multiplication and Division with Whole Numbers
modules.description: Multiplying up to 4 digits by 1 digit and 2 digits by 2 digits using area models, partial products, and finding remainders in division.

topics.title: Multiplication by 10, 100, and 1,000
topics.description: Using arrays and place value understanding to multiply multiples of 10, 100, and 1000.

topics.title: Area Models and Partial Products for 2-Digit by 2-Digit Multiplication
topics.description: Decomposing factors into tens and ones and calculating four partial products.

topics.title: Division with Remainders and Multi-Digit Quotients
topics.description: Dividing up to 4-digit dividends by 1-digit divisors with area models and partial quotients.

modules.title: Fraction Equivalence, Ordering, and Operations
modules.description: Decomposing fractions into sums of unit fractions, multiplying fractions by whole numbers, and adding fractions with denominators 10 and 100.

topics.title: Equivalent Fractions with Area Models and Tape Diagrams
topics.description: Multiplying or dividing numerator and denominator by common factors to find equivalence.

topics.title: Addition and Subtraction of Fractions with Like Denominators
topics.description: Combining fractional parts and converting between improper fractions and mixed numbers.

topics.title: Multiplying a Fraction by a Whole Number
topics.description: Understanding n x (a/b) as n x a copies of 1/b.

topics.title: Decimals as Fractions with Denominators 10 and 100
topics.description: Converting tenths and hundredths into decimal notation and comparing decimals.

modules.title: Angle Measurement and Plane Figures
modules.description: Measuring angles with protractors, classifying angles (acute, right, obtuse, straight), and identifying parallel and perpendicular lines.

topics.title: Lines, Rays, Angles and Triangles
topics.description: Classifying 2D figures based on presence or absence of parallel/perpendicular lines and angle types.

topics.title: Angle Measurement and Protractors
topics.description: Understanding an angle as a fraction of a 360-degree circle and measuring with protractors.

topics.title: Lines of Symmetry
topics.description: Identifying and drawing lines of symmetry in two-dimensional geometric figures.
